verdict.rationale: Kong offers a live, auth-gated Konnect MCP server (confirmed via hands-on probe) that lets AI agents/assistants operate the platform through natural-language-driven tool calls, and Insomnia supports natural-language prompts to generate mock servers/AI assistance. However, core Kong Gateway administration is still done via Admin API, decK CLI, or Kong Manager UI rather than conversational commands, so NL operability is partial and feature-specific rather than pervasive.
